acts.title: Portal Night
acts.blurb: You crawl out of the portal. Learn to roll, smash, shop and hold Downtown.

acts.title: The Harbor Wars
acts.blurb: Bigger brawls, evolutions and a second city space on the water.

acts.title: Spire of the Crown
acts.blurb: Stolen rolls, curses and the schemer who opened the portal.

twists.how: After newGame builds G.pl and before the first startTurn, set the boss seat's en to param (energy for its first buy).
After newGame builds G.pl and before the first startTurn, set the boss seat's vp to param (a head start on the 20-star race).
After refill() in newGame, remove the first deck card whose base() equals param (a Keep card id such as 'plated') and push it onto the boss seat's cards.
After newGame builds G.pl and before the first startTurn, set G.city to the boss seat's index so it begins in Downtown, with no +1 star for entering.
In ai.js aiYield, return false for the boss seat while its hp is at least param, so it never gives up the city while healthy.
After newGame builds G.pl (Brainjack Taster or Full Set only), add param to the boss seat's mb Brainjack tokens.

intro.text: Hold the front page! A new monster just climbed out of the portal. That's you.
Roll your dice, tap the ones you like to keep them, and reroll the rest. Twice.
Hrrm. Shroomhulk is sleepy. Shroomhulk will smash you slowly.

outro.text: Tomorrow's headline: NEWCOMER FLATTENS SPORE BRUTE. Keep that up and I'll need more ink.

opponent.name: Shroomhulk
opponent.personality: Slow and sleepy; keeps the wrong dice and rarely buys anything.

goal.text: Win the game: reach 20 stars or be the last monster standing.

easier.text: Shroomhulk dozes off even more; the hints stay on.

intro.text: The crown sits in Downtown. Whoever starts a turn there gains 2 stars.
But everyone outside hits the monster inside. Yield when you're hurt, take it back later.
The storm drains are mine, and so is Downtown. Come and drag me out, slimy rookie.

outro.text: You held the city and kept your head. That's the whole trick of Crown City.

opponent.name: Squidrik
opponent.personality: Loves Downtown and stays too long; yields at random.

goal.text: Win the game after starting at least 2 turns in Downtown.

stars.text: Win after starting 2+ turns in Downtown
Start 4 or more turns in Downtown

easier.text: Squidrik forgets to fight back as often.

intro.text: Energy is money here. Spend it on power cards before the others snap them up.
Don't like what's for sale? Pay 2 energy to sweep the cards and deal fresh ones.
DEMOLITION ROUTINE LOADED. SHOPPING ROUTINE: ALSO LOADED.

outro.text: Three monsters, one winner, and a fistful of power cards. Nice shopping.

opponent.name: Boltbox
opponent.personality: Hoards energy, then buys whatever it sees first.

goal.text: Win a 3-monster game after buying at least 2 power cards.

easier.text: Only Boltbox shows up; the third monster stays home.

intro.text: Baron Magmaw has ruled Downtown for a week. The fire brigade has given up.
You can win two ways: 20 stars, or be the last one standing. Pick your moment.
Little portal-pup. My pincers are molten and my wallet is full. Bow.

outro.text: MAGMAW COOLS INTO ROCK! Front page, all editions.
But my harbor stringer says something cold is moving in off the water...

opponent.name: Baron Magmaw
opponent.personality: Proud and greedy; buys big cards and sits in Downtown until it is nearly cooked.
opponent.taunt: Ha! Downtown stays hot, and it stays mine.
opponent.praise: You... cooled me. Fine. The Baron yields the city to you.

twist.text: Boss rule: Baron Magmaw starts with 3 energy for his first shopping trip.

goal.text: Beat Baron Magmaw: win a 3-monster game.

easier.text: Magmaw comes alone and without his head-start energy.

intro.text: Something in the portal glow is changing the monsters. They call it evolving.
Resolve three hearts and you pick an evolution card. Play it when its text allows.
SNORT. Voltusk chewed a substation and grew new tusks. Want to see?

outro.text: Four monsters, all evolving, and you came out on top. The city is paying attention.

opponent.name: Voltusk
opponent.personality: Charges into Downtown and plays its evolutions as soon as it can.

goal.text: Win a 4-monster game with evolutions on.

stars.text: Win by 5 or more stars over the next monster

easier.text: Three monsters instead of four, and they play loosely.

intro.text: Five monsters in town, so the Harbor opens as a second city space.
Squidrik slithered back up the drains and already sits in Downtown. Pry it loose.
Remember me? This time I brought the whole storm drain with me.

outro.text: Twenty stars the honest way. My readers love a points race.

opponent.name: Squidrik
opponent.personality: Back for revenge; squats in the city and slithers out the moment it is badly hurt.

twist.text: Rival rule: Squidrik starts the game in Downtown.

goal.text: Win by reaching 20 stars (a knockout win does not count).

stars.text: Start 3 or more turns in the city

easier.text: Four monsters, a gentler table, and Squidrik starts outside.

intro.text: The bay froze overnight. Glacyx walked out of it and straight into Downtown.
It will not yield while it's healthy. Wear it down from outside, together or alone.
I am patient as winter. Your claws will tire long before my ice cracks.

outro.text: GLACYX MELTS AWAY. The harbor thaws and the boats come home.
One odd thing: the ice had thoughts frozen in it. Someone was steering Glacyx.

opponent.name: Glacyx, the Harbor Frost
opponent.personality: Cold and stubborn; grabs Downtown and refuses to leave while it has hearts to spare.
opponent.taunt: Winter always wins. Go home and thaw out, little one.
opponent.praise: Cracked... The ice gives way. The city is yours, for now.

twist.text: Boss rule: Glacyx never yields the city while it has 4 or more hearts.

goal.text: Beat Glacyx: win a 4-monster game with evolutions on.

easier.text: Glacyx thaws: it yields like anyone else and the table is smaller.

intro.text: New monsters, new trick: each starts with a Brainjack token.
Spend it after a rival's last roll to resolve their dice as your own. Use it once, wisely.
Skree! Your roll looks tasty. Mind if I drink it?

outro.text: You stole the right roll at the right time. That's how the smart ones play.

opponent.name: Bramblebat
opponent.personality: Sharp and sneaky; saves its Brainjack token for your best roll.

easier.text: Only Bramblebat, and it thinks one step ahead instead of every step.

intro.text: A curse hangs over the city now, and the Omen Die can swap it any turn.
Boltbox rebuilt itself with armour plates. Read the curse before you charge.
UPGRADE COMPLETE. PLATED HIDE INSTALLED. RESUMING DEMOLITION.

outro.text: Curse, armour and all, you came through. Only the Crown Spire is left.

opponent.name: Boltbox Mk II
opponent.personality: Methodical; tests every reroll and shrugs off small hits.

twist.text: Rival rule: Boltbox starts with Plated Hide already bolted on.

goal.text: Win a 4-monster game with Curses on.

stars.text: Win by 4 or more stars over the next monster

easier.text: No armour for Boltbox, one fewer monster, and steadier play.

intro.text: Found it. Cortexa opened the portal and has been steering monsters ever since.
The Crown Spire is up: hold the city and roll four 1s to climb. The top level wins outright.
Every roll you make, I have already read. Every roll you make, I may take.

outro.text: CORTEXA LOSES ITS MIND! The portal flickers shut.
And the crown? It's yours. Long live the monarch of Crown City.

opponent.name: Cortexa, Mind of the Portal
opponent.personality: A cold schemer; hoards Brainjack tokens and steals the roll that would win you the game.
opponent.taunt: I saw that coming three rolls ago. The crown was always mine.
opponent.praise: Impossible... you thought of something I didn't. Take the crown.

twist.text: Boss rule: Cortexa starts with 2 extra Brainjack tokens (3 in all).

goal.text: Beat Cortexa: win a 4-monster game with the Crown Spire on.

easier.text: Cortexa keeps only its single token, thinks less deeply, and one rival stays home.
